LOCALE_TAGS

Locale code → metadata tags. bcp is the BCP-47 tag used in hreflang, <html lang> and JSON-LD inLanguage; og is the xx_YY form og:locale requires. Dialects without a standardized region keep their ISO-639-3 tag and map og:locale to the closest standardized culture. Sole declaration site — the static-page generator imports this file so runtime head sync and emitted HTML can never diverge.
